false_positives.evidence: A 12-word wallet mnemonic is assigned to mnemonic in the unauthenticated submitKey handler.
false_positives.fix: Revoke and replace the wallet, remove the mnemonic from source, and inject any required secret at runtime.
false_positives.title: Ethereum wallet recovery phrase is embedded in a public handler
false_positives.why: The recovery phrase derives the wallet private key and can be extracted from the source or deployed build.

false_positives.evidence: POST /rest/user/login is registered without rate-limiting middleware, while rate limiting is only configured for reset-password and selected 2FA routes.
false_positives.fix: Apply a server-side login rate limit keyed to an account identifier and a trustworthy client address, with progressive delays or temporary lockout.
false_positives.title: Login endpoint has no credential-attempt limit
false_positives.why: An unauthenticated attacker can repeatedly submit passwords for an account without an application-enforced attempt limit.

false_positives.evidence: yaml.load processes attacker-controlled upload data rather than a safe schema or safeLoad equivalent.
false_positives.fix: Use a safe YAML schema for untrusted input and reject custom tags and executable types.
false_positives.title: Uploaded YAML reaches an unsafe full-schema deserializer

trace.note: Uploaded YAML bytes are converted to data.

false_positives.why: The full js-yaml loader accepts unsafe YAML types from a public upload endpoint, allowing attacker-controlled deserialization behavior.

false_positives.evidence: Checkout loads a basket by req.params.id without checking its UserId against the authenticated requester.
false_positives.fix: Authorize ownership while loading the basket and perform checkout and basket-item deletion within an ownership-scoped transaction.
false_positives.title: Checkout changes any basket selected by its ID

trace.note: The selected basket ID is used to delete BasketItems after checkout.

false_positives.why: An authenticated attacker can check out another user's basket and clear its BasketItems.

false_positives.evidence: The authenticated coupon handler finds and updates BasketModel using only params.id.
false_positives.fix: Scope the basket lookup and update to the authenticated user's ID.
false_positives.title: Coupon endpoint modifies another user's basket by ID

trace.note: The selected basket is updated without an ownership condition.

false_positives.why: An authenticated user can change the coupon on another customer's basket by supplying its identifier.
